title: Weekly Reset
concept: A scheduled check-in in five parts, about 40 minutes — appreciation, checking the load is fair, one friction point, requests, next steps. Not a trial.
whenToUse: Same day and time each week; also after travel, stress, or distance. Not for hashing out a fight — if either of you is overwhelmed, take a Pause + Return first.
steps: Appreciation (5 min) — one specific thing each.
Check the load (15 min) — do you feel supported? Alone? Is it fair? Once a month, this part is the monthly Care Check-in (inside the Weekly Reset).
One friction point (15 min) — one small thing each; keep it to a small step, not the whole fix.
Requests — one specific ask each, for next week.
Next steps — one thing to try, and when you’ll check back in. Requests and next steps share the last 5 minutes.

phrases.text: I felt supported when ___. Alone when ___.

working: Forty minutes on the timer, appreciation first. It ends with one phone-free evening planned and a check-in on Sunday. Small things stay small.
notWorking: Opening with Wednesday’s row, skipping the appreciation, no timer. The check-in turns into a trial. Save the big stuff for its own repair conversation.
activity: Put four weeks on the calendar. Set a 40-minute timer. Only the five parts fit in 40 minutes: anything else (Proof reviews, plans for fun, the bigger picture) goes to the Monthly Review, a longer once-a-month look at how things are going. Use the in-app Weekly Reset wizard.
